exposure: Mode of HPV vaccine delivery (subsidised opportunistic, free-of-charge catch-up outside-school, and free-of-charge school-based)
cohort: 689,676 girls born between 1990 and 2003 in Sweden
finding: Free-of-charge school-based HPV vaccination achieved the highest uptake and displayed the least disparity in uptake related to parental country of birth and socioeconomic background.
